title: B5
query: Find all the proteins that are associated with the same pathways and conduct the same ions as the protein 'KCNG3'.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (k:Protein {label: 'KCNG3'}) WITH k MATCH (k)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway) WITH k, collect(DISTINCT pw) AS k_pws MATCH (k)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion:Ion) WITH k, k_pws, collect(DISTINCT ion) AS k_ions MATCH (other:Protein) WHERE other <> k WITH k, k_pws, k_ions, other MATCH (other)-[:hasPathway]->(other_pw:Pathway) WITH k, k_pws, k_ions, other, collect(DISTINCT other_pw) AS other_pws MATCH (other)-[:hasIonAsso]->(other_ion:Ion) WITH k, k_pws, k_ions, other, other_pws, collect(DISTINCT other_ion) AS other_ions WHERE size(other_pws) = size(k_pws)   AND size(other_ions) = size(k_ions)   AND all(x IN other_pws WHERE x IN k_pws)   AND all(x IN k_pws WHERE x IN other_pws)   AND all(y IN other_ions WHERE y IN k_ions)   AND all(y IN k_ions WHERE y IN other_ions) RETURN DISTINCT other.label AS protein LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {label: 'KCNG3'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway) WITH p, collect(DISTINCT path) AS pathways OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion:Ion) WITH pathways, collect(DISTINCT ion) AS ions MATCH (other:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway)   WHERE path IN pathways MATCH (other)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion:Ion)   WHERE ion IN ions AND other.label <> 'KCNG3' RETURN DISTINCT other.label AS Protein LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p) WHERE p.label = 'KCNG3' AND (p:Protein OR p:LightKinase OR p:DarkKinase OR p:LightIonChannel OR p:DarkIonChannel) WITH p MATCH (p)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway) WITH p, collect(DISTINCT pw) AS pathways MATCH (p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion:Ion) WITH p, pathways, collect(DISTINCT ion) AS ions MATCH (other) WHERE (other:Protein OR other:LightKinase OR other:DarkKinase OR other:LightIonChannel OR other:DarkIonChannel) AND other <> p MATCH (other)-[:hasPathway]->(pw2:Pathway) WHERE pw2 IN pathways MATCH (other)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion2:Ion) WHERE ion2 IN ions RETURN DISTINCT other.label LIMIT 100
